name: Still Life x FreeTerraForged Bridge
description: Places Still Life's biomes properly on FreeTerraForged terrain: oceans, coasts, mountains and continents get the biomes Still Life meant for them. Also (each in config/stilllife_ftf_bridge.properties, saved per world): beaches like Still Life's own; Still Life's snow on peaks at every altitude, with a snow line that wanders and fades in patchily instead of a level edge; wetlands kept off hillsides; humid lowland swamps; aspen swamps and salt lakes on dry flat land; standing water in Still Life's wetlands and salt lakes at any height; irregular, blended borders where two continents with different Still Life biome sets meet; adjustable VanillaBackport biomes; and the coastal "uplift cliff" turned into gentle terraces. Needs FreeTerraForged 1.0.0027 or later.
